token.label: API Key
token.description:
To get your API key:
1. Open [Settings → Developer → API Keys](https://app.cal.com/settings/developer/api-keys) in Cal.com.
2. Create a new key and choose when it expires.
3. Copy the key (it starts with `cal_`) and paste it here.

calcom_list_event_types.label: List Event Types
calcom_list_event_types.description: List Cal.com event types, optionally filtered by owner.

username.label: Username
username.description: Only event types owned by this Cal.com username. Leave empty to list your own.

event_slug.label: Event Slug
event_slug.description: Filter to the event type with this exact slug. Requires Username to be set too.

org_slug.label: Organization Slug
org_slug.description: Only used together with Username / Event Slug when booking through an organization.

calcom_get_event_type.label: Get Event Type
calcom_get_event_type.description: Get the full configuration of a single Cal.com event type by id.

event_type_id.label: Event Type ID
event_type_id.description: Get this from List Event Types.

calcom_create_event_type.label: Create Event Type
calcom_create_event_type.description: Create a new Cal.com event type.

slug.label: Slug
slug.description: URL-safe identifier for the event type, must be unique.

schedule_id.label: Schedule ID
schedule_id.description: Assign a different availability schedule than the owner's default one. Get this from List Schedules.

additional_fields.label: Additional Fields
additional_fields.description: Advanced event-type fields not listed above, as a JSON object matching the Cal.com v2 Create Event Type request body (e.g. {"bookingLimitsCount": {...}}).

calcom_update_event_type.label: Update Event Type
calcom_update_event_type.description: Update an existing Cal.com event type. Only the fields you set are changed.

event_type_id.label: Event Type ID
event_type_id.description: Get this from List Event Types.

schedule_id.label: Schedule ID
schedule_id.description: Assign a different availability schedule than the owner's default one. Get this from List Schedules.

hidden.label: Hidden
hidden.description: Leave unset to keep the current visibility.

additional_fields.label: Additional Fields
additional_fields.description: Advanced event-type fields not listed above, as a JSON object matching the Cal.com v2 Update Event Type request body (e.g. {"bookingLimitsCount": {...}}).

calcom_delete_event_type.label: Delete Event Type
calcom_delete_event_type.description: Permanently delete a Cal.com event type by id.

event_type_id.label: Event Type ID
event_type_id.description: Get this from List Event Types.

calcom_get_booking.label: Get Booking
calcom_get_booking.description: Get the full details of a single Cal.com booking by its uid, including its attendees.

calcom_create_booking.label: Create Booking
calcom_create_booking.description: Book a Cal.com event type at a specific start time for one attendee.

event_type_id.label: Event Type ID
event_type_id.description: Get this from List Event Types.

start.label: Start Time
start.description: ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC, e.g. 2026-03-05T15:00:00Z. Get a valid value from Get Available Slots.

attendee_time_zone.label: Attendee Timezone
attendee_time_zone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Get valid values from List Timezones.

length_in_minutes.label: Length (Minutes)
length_in_minutes.description: Only for event types offering multiple possible durations.

calcom_cancel_booking.label: Cancel Booking
calcom_cancel_booking.description: Cancel an active Cal.com booking by its uid.

calcom_reschedule_booking.label: Reschedule Booking
calcom_reschedule_booking.description: Move a Cal.com booking to a new start time.

calcom_confirm_booking.label: Confirm Booking
calcom_confirm_booking.description: Confirm a Cal.com booking that is pending host confirmation.

calcom_decline_booking.label: Decline Booking
calcom_decline_booking.description: Decline a Cal.com booking that is pending host confirmation.

calcom_mark_booking_no_show.label: Mark Booking No-Show
calcom_mark_booking_no_show.description: Mark the host and/or a specific attendee absent for a Cal.com booking.

attendee_email.label: Attendee Email
attendee_email.description: Leave empty to only set Host Absent.

attendee_absent.label: Attendee Absent
attendee_absent.description: Only used together with Attendee Email. Defaults to Yes.

calcom_add_attendee.label: Add Attendee to Booking
calcom_add_attendee.description: Add an additional attendee to an existing Cal.com booking.

time_zone.label: Attendee Timezone
time_zone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Get valid values from List Timezones.

calcom_get_available_slots.label: Get Available Slots
calcom_get_available_slots.description: Find bookable time slots for a Cal.com event type within a time range.

event_type_id.label: Event Type ID
event_type_id.description: Get this from List Event Types.

start.label: Start
start.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for the beginning of the search range.

end.label: End
end.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for the end of the search range.

time_zone.label: Timezone
time_zone.description: IANA timezone the returned slots are expressed in.

duration.label: Duration (Minutes)
duration.description: Only for event types offering multiple possible durations.

calcom_list_schedules.label: List Schedules
calcom_list_schedules.description: List all of the connected user's availability schedules.

calcom_get_schedule.label: Get Schedule
calcom_get_schedule.description: Get the full details of one availability schedule by id.

calcom_update_schedule.label: Update Schedule
calcom_update_schedule.description: Update an existing availability schedule. Only the fields you set are changed.

is_default.label: Is Default
is_default.description: Leave unset to keep the current default schedule unchanged.

availability.label: Availability (full replacement)
availability.description: If set, replaces the entire weekly availability array, e.g. [{"days": ["Monday"], "startTime": "09:00", "endTime": "17:00"}].

overrides.label: Date Overrides (full replacement)
overrides.description: If set, replaces the entire date-overrides array, e.g. [{"date": "2026-05-20", "startTime": "12:00", "endTime": "13:00"}].

calcom_delete_schedule.label: Delete Schedule
calcom_delete_schedule.description: Permanently delete an availability schedule by id.

calcom_get_default_schedule.label: Get Default Schedule
calcom_get_default_schedule.description: Get the connected user's default availability schedule.

calcom_list_timezones.label: List Timezones
calcom_list_timezones.description: List valid IANA timezone strings Cal.com accepts.

calcom_get_my_profile.label: Get My Profile
calcom_get_my_profile.description: Get the profile of the connected Cal.com user.

calcom_update_my_profile.label: Update My Profile
calcom_update_my_profile.description: Update the connected Cal.com user's own profile. Only the fields you set are changed.

time_zone.label: Timezone
time_zone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Get valid values from List Timezones.

calcom_list_teams.label: List Teams
calcom_list_teams.description: List the teams the connected Cal.com user belongs to.
